answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The umber edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 161 clones produces a signature the forge analysis flags immediately. An adversary must therefore build an open graph reaching real agents, thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the onyx settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 5 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
